description: Department of Fiscal Policy - The Excise (Security Features) Rules 2019
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the establishment of new regulatory rules (Excise (security features) Rules 2019) under the Excise Ordinance. It creates a legal framework for sticker requirements on excisable articles, specifies compliance procedures, and outlines enforcement mechanisms. The content focuses on regulatory requirements and legal obligations rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
